rows.title: fix(ci): stop splicing untrusted step outputs into shell run blocks
rows.author: lgalabru
rows.summary: - Provider directory names under `providers/` are contributor-controlled and were being spliced as raw `${{ steps.X.outputs.Y }}` / `${{ inputs.fqn_N }}` text directly into `run:` shell blocks in `build-skills.yml`, `validate.yml`, and `circuit-breaker.yml`. GitHub Actions performs this substitution as literal script text *before* bash parses it, so a directory name (or manually-typed FQN) containing shell metacharacters (`$(...)`, backticks, `;`, quotes) is executed rather than treated as data — a standard GitHub Actions script-injection primitive.
rows.outreachAngle: agent-payment launch-readiness public-surface pass
